'''Le-Laar Joom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] who worked as a talent [[Scout/Legends|scout]] for the company [[Industrial Heuristics]], during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Joom and the [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Eraffa]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], to recruit students to develop war sciences for Industrial Heuristics. The pair tested the proficiency of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tan Tengo]], and subsequently persuaded Tengo's grandfather, [[Gub Tengo]], to allow the child to join Industrial Heuristics.
